title: Acyclicity of a pulled-back affine-open direct image
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $X$ a scheme, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ separated, and $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ arbitrary. Write $p:X_B\to X$ and $f_B:X_B\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ for the projections of $X_B=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $W\subseteq X$ is an affine open and $G$ is a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, then $p^*(j_*(G|_W))$ [def-pc-module-pullback], where $j:W\hookrightarrow X$, is $f_{B,*}$-acyclic [def-sp-acyclic]: its higher right derived direct images in all positive natural degrees vanish. No flatness, cover, complex or derived-category choice is assumed.

proof.text: W and Spec A are affine, so W->Spec A is affine. Since f is separated, the Mathlib postcomposition property gives that j:W->X is affine. The morphism g between affine schemes is affine, so its base change p is affine. Hence W prime=p inverse W is an affine open. All these are direct Mathlib instances or theorems, also for the empty open.

Use uniqueness of left adjoints to identify tensorPullback with the standard module pullback. Standard pullback preserves quasi-coherence. Its restriction/pullback and composition isomorphisms, together with p_W followed by j = j prime followed by p, give an isomorphism (p*G)|W prime -> p_W*(G|W). This is the explicit chain eR in Lean.

Apply affinePushforward_baseChange to the restriction pullback square with f=j, f prime=j prime, base map=p, and upper map=p_W. It gives an isomorphism p*(j_*G|W) -> j prime_*(p_W*G|W). Compose with j prime_* of the inverse restriction comparison to obtain j prime_*((p*G)|W prime). Since f_B is separated and p*G is quasi-coherent, affine_open_pushforward_rightAcyclic applies to this object. Transport rightAcyclic across the composite isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem affine_open_pushforward_pullback_rightAcyclic {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A) [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G] : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightAcyclic ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).obj (G.restrict W.ι)))
